items.briefing:
Australian small businesses are being increasingly targeted by AI-generated scams that are more convincing and personalised than ever before, making them harder to spot. Separately, the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) has flagged active attacks on TeamCity servers here in Australia — if your organisation uses this software for development, ensure it is patched immediately.

With attackers moving faster than ever to exploit known software weaknesses, keeping all software and systems up to date remains critical. **Practical tip:** Check with your IT provider today whether your TeamCity or any other development tools have outstanding security updates waiting to be applied.

featured.title: AI fuels targeted scams against Australian small firms
featured.summary: Targeted fraud is inflicting bigger losses on small firms as AI helps criminals forge convincing invoices and impersonations in Australia.
